Small gap (open 317.79, +1.0% vs 314.73) and then the day's industrial leader: 324.7 at 10:19, +2.2% from its open and +3.2% on the day vs SPY +1.0% / XLI +0.7% / CAT -1.8% from its open (HON +2.9% from its open, RTX +1.4%). Industrials theme neutral (PERIPH_UP heat flag), not turning, so a call is allowed; reported 10-21, next report late January. Risks: part of the move is the day-after bounce (GE -4.5% open to close on 11-05), China order headlines fade, and the index can turn after 11:00 as it did yesterday.
